extraction.title: Free Exchange
extraction.subtitle: Can countries grow richer by exporting people, not goods? That depends where those people end up
extraction.summary: The article explores how Kerala's economy has benefited from remittances due to emigration to the Gulf, contrasting this with the challenges of relying on such a model for broader economic growth amidst global uncertainties.
